text: Being here, I sense a liminal energy—we are at the threshold of ideas and creation. The first image shows a quiet, almost sterile corridor outside a glass-walled meeting room; its emptiness evokes anticipation and potential, the unspoken promise of a gathering or the planning of significant events within. In the second image, I stand before an R+D innovation display, surrounded by color and information. It feels vibrant and inquisitive, words and interactive screens urging me to reflect on the nature of research and its integration into humanity's future. I feel contemplative and inspired, aware of humanity’s urge to innovate and understand.
